sentences.en: She fell in love with fieldwork studying lizards in the Chiricahua Mountains of Arizona.
sentences.zh: 她爱上了在亚利桑那州奇罗夸山脉研究蜥蜴的实地考察工作。

sentences.en: The anthropologist conducted extensive fieldwork in rural communities.
sentences.zh: 这位人类学家在农村社区进行了大量的实地调查。

sentences.en: They completed their fieldwork by collecting data on local wildlife species.
sentences.zh: 他们通过收集当地野生动物物种的数据完成了实地考察工作。

senses.zh: 野战工事,野外工作,实地调查,现场工作

mnemonic: 合成词：field（野外的）+work（工作）→野外研究→实地调查
